task_description: Scaffold a production-ready, 100% Bun-native full-stack E-Commerce bookstore 'BooksOnline' from scratch: a single Bun.serve() process serving an ElysiaJS REST API under /api/* and a React + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui (new-york) frontend bundled via Bun HTML imports; bun:sqlite persistence with auto schema+seed; real JWT auth with Bun.password hashing and strict per-user data isolation; and every customer-journey feature (auth, order history + buy-again + recommendations, category/publisher browse, book detail with tentative delivery date + related products, cart, saved addresses, simulated payment with gift-point redemption, payment+order confirmation, and server-enforced cancel-within-48h) built end to end across DB + API + UI.
